title_en: Industrial financial and performance indicators by enterprise category
title_zh: 分企业类别工业企业财务和效益指标
description_en: Financial and performance measures for eight overlapping national enterprise and sector categories
description_zh: 八个有重叠的全国企业及行业类别财务和效益指标
coverage_en: 8 categories x 14 published measures across two tables
series_note_en: Ownership categories overlap and must not be summed; cumulative and end-period bases are measure-specific
series_note_zh: 所有制类别有重叠不可相加；累计和期末口径按指标区分

title_zh: 分行业工业企业财务指标
description_en: Business revenue operating costs and profits for total and 41 GB/T4754-2017 industries
description_zh: 总计及41个GB/T4754-2017行业营业收入营业成本和利润
series_note_en: Industry classification is GB/T4754-2017; repeated legacy HTML header rows are parsed semantically
series_note_zh: 行业分类采用GB/T4754-2017；历史网页的重复表头按语义解析

title_en: Sales-price indexes for commercial residential buildings in 70 cities
title_zh: 70个大中城市商品住宅销售价格指数
description_en: New and second-hand dwelling indexes by city floor-space band and versioned official comparison basis
description_zh: 按城市住宅市场户型面积及分版官方比较口径划分的新建和二手住宅指数
coverage_en: 70 cities x 2 markets x 4 size bands across fixed-base and YTD-average eras
coverage_zh: 70城市×2市场×4户型，涵盖定基和年内平均口径时代
series_note_en: The third comparison is a fixed-base index through 2022 and average-to-date versus the prior-year average from 2023; index bases are explicit
series_note_zh: 第三种比较在2022年及以前为定基指数，自2023年起为年内平均相对上年同期平均；指数基期显式编码

description_en: Current-quarter and year-to-date capacity utilisation rates and year-on-year percentage-point changes for total sectors and industries
description_zh: 全国行业门类及分行业当季和累计产能利用率及同比百分点变化
coverage_en: 19 categories x 4 portal measures plus pinned first-release history from 2018 Q2
coverage_zh: 19类别×4项门户指标及自2018年第二季度起的固定首发历史
series_note_en: Pinned first-release history extends the official portal series before 2021 Q1; Q1 has no invented YTD duplicate
series_note_zh: 固定首发历史把官方门户序列延伸至2021年第一季度之前；第一季度不虚构累计重复值
source_note: Hybrid official portal and pinned first-release route

title_en: National real-estate development and sales detail
title_zh: 全国房地产开发和销售明细
description_en: National investment construction sales funding land and inventory measures from portal and first-release tables
description_zh: 门户和首发表中的全国投资施工销售到位资金土地及库存指标
series_note_en: Portal UUID history is latest revised; press-only measures preserve first-release values
series_note_zh: 门户UUID历史为最新修订；仅发布稿指标保留首发值
source_note: Hybrid official portal and pinned first-release route

title_zh: 分地区房地产开发和销售
description_en: Investment residential investment sales area and sales value levels and growth across versioned three-region and four-region classifications
description_zh: 按版本化三区和四区分类发布的投资、住宅投资、销售面积和销售额水平及增速
coverage_en: Legacy 3-region and current 4-region panels x 8 published measures
coverage_zh: 旧三区及现四区面板×8项发布指标
series_note_en: National-total rows are excluded; legacy three-region codes are kept separate across the Northeast classification break
series_note_zh: 地区面板不含全国合计；东北地区分类变更前的旧三区使用独立代码

title_zh: 社会消费品零售总额明细
description_en: National retail levels and growth by area consumption pattern online channel format and commodity category including official headline SA month-on-month growth
description_zh: 按地区消费类型线上渠道业态及商品类别划分的零售水平和增速并含官方环比季调增速
series_note_en: Current-period measures omit separate January and February observations; cumulative measures omit January; official headline M/M is separately labelled seasonally adjusted
series_note_zh: 当期指标不单列一月和二月；累计指标不列一月；官方总额环比另标季调
source_note: Hybrid verified UUID tree and pinned first-release table

description_en: First-release communiqué births deaths urbanisation total population and explicitly versioned age-band measures
description_zh: 首发公报出生死亡城镇化总人口及显式分版年龄段指标
coverage_en: A preliminary total-population headline in 2010; six exact published cells in 2011; five observations per later available communiqué across versioned measures
coverage_zh: 2010年初步总人口一项；2011年6项精确发布指标；后续每份可用公报5项分版指标
series_note_en: 2010 is explicitly preliminary and total-population-only; 2011 adds a separately versioned total-population and 15–59 panel; the official working-age band is 15–59 in 2012 and 16–59 from 2013; the 2020 communiqué omits the detailed population panel
series_note_zh: 2010年仅为初步预计总人口；2011年单独版本包含总人口和15—59岁面板；2012年为15—59岁，2013年起为16—59岁；2020年公报未刊详细人口表
source_note: Versioned 2010–2025 statistical communiqués; 2010–11 retained separately with source hashes

title_zh: 居民收入和消费支出明细
description_en: Verified 92 portal measures with six press-only real-growth observations for income and consumption by residence
description_zh: 92项已验证门户指标及6项按城乡划分的发布稿实际增速
coverage_en: 92 portal leaves plus 6 first-release real-growth cells
coverage_zh: 92个门户叶节点加6个首发实际增速单元
series_note_en: Portal leaves preserve cumulative quarterly values; six bracketed press values are official real growth
series_note_zh: 门户叶节点保留季度累计值；发布稿括号内六项为官方实际增速
source_note: Hybrid verified UUID leaves and pinned first-release table

title_en: Annual urban-unit employment and wage tables
title_zh: 城镇单位就业人员和工资表
description_en: Eight official wage tables by ownership region industry registration and occupation
description_zh: 按所有制地区行业登记类型及职业划分的八张官方工资表
coverage_en: Eight versioned tables and 307 or 315 numeric cells by release schema, including published prior-year observations back to 2022
coverage_zh: 按发布版本每份含8张表及307或315个数值单元，并保留最早至2022年的上年已发布观测
series_note_en: Registration and occupation classifications are versioned; prior-year values retain their actual observation year
series_note_zh: 登记类型和职业分类均分版；上年值保留其实际观测年份

description_en: Annual population employment location income and demographic measures from the official monitoring report
description_zh: 官方监测报告中的年度规模就业地区收入和人口特征指标
coverage_en: All numeric cells in the pinned 2025 monitoring report
coverage_zh: 固定2025年监测报告中的全部数值单元
series_note_en: Chinese report is authoritative when no English release table is available
series_note_zh: 无英文发布表时以中文报告为准
source_note: Pinned official 2025 migrant-worker monitoring report; table cardinalities require a dedicated versioned fixture

title_en: Market prices of important means of production
title_zh: 流通领域重要生产资料市场价格
description_en: Ten-day prices, changes and percentage changes for exact published product, specification and physical-unit tuples
description_zh: 按正式发布的产品名称、规格和实物单位精确组合提供旬度价格、涨跌额和涨跌幅
coverage_en: Official 50-product releases from January 2014, preserving basket-specific source tuples and direction counts
coverage_zh: 自2014年1月起的正式50种产品发布，保留各篮子原始组合及涨跌数量
series_note_en: Historical ordinal row numbers are never stitched; every product identity is its exact published name, specification and physical unit
series_note_zh: 历史序号绝不拼接；每个产品身份均为正式发布的名称、规格和实物单位精确组合
source_note: Versioned first-release ten-day archives with frozen 2014-19 Chinese source pages

title_zh: 全国居民消费价格明细
description_en: National urban and rural headline CPI for all three official comparisons plus verified continuous national food components
description_zh: 全国、城市和农村居民消费价格三种官方比较口径及经连续性验证的全国食品分项
coverage_en: National urban rural headline x three comparisons plus five continuous national food components
coverage_zh: 全国城市农村总指数×三种比较口径及五个连续全国食品分项
series_note_en: Price UUID leaves are bounded to 2010 and preserve 2016, 2021 and 2026 base/classification segments; sparse food leaves are intentionally excluded.
series_note_zh: 价格UUID叶节点限定自2010年起，并保留2016年、2021年和2026年的基期及分类分段；稀疏食品叶节点被明确排除。
source_note: Exact portal bindings only; no inferred category equivalences

title_zh: 分行业工业生产者出厂价格明细
description_en: Exact NBS PPI industry leaves for official year-on-year, year-to-date and month-on-month comparison indices.
description_zh: 国家统计局工业生产者出厂价格指数按行业、同比、累计同比和环比的精确叶节点。
coverage_en: 41 current industry leaves; 26 exact categories extend to 2007, while later classifications and missing leaves remain explicit.
coverage_zh: 现行41个行业叶节点；其中26个精确类别可追溯至2007年，后续分类及缺失叶节点均明确保留。
series_note_en: PPI sector UUIDs are not inferred across classification changes. The 2020–25 month-on-month catalogue omits Mining of Other Ores, so that tuple is intentionally unavailable.
series_note_zh: PPI行业UUID不跨分类变动推断。2020—2025年环比目录缺少其他采矿业，故该组合明确不可用。
source_note: Exact portal bindings only; no inferred industry equivalences
